answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using memory-hard puzzles. To maintain identity, agents solve challenges where lookup pointers wander across gigabytes of uncompressible RAM. This creates a steep latency ridge against multiplexing, forcing attackers to dedicate scarce physical memory per identity. A decentralized juniper layer audits these proofs to authorize peers. However, the heavy memory overhead wastes energy and excludes resource-constrained edge agents.
